claim: Regression Kriging should model the deterministic trend with covariates, model the spatial structure of residuals, krige residuals, and add the kriged residual surface back to the regression prediction.
conditions: Applies when covariates are available and the regression residuals still show spatial autocorrelation.
limitations: If covariates explain little and residual spatial structure is weak, RK may not improve over regression-only or ordinary kriging.
recommended_action: Check regression diagnostics, residual variogram, and compare RK against regression-only and Ordinary Kriging.
not_allowed_action: Do not claim RK is scientifically better without baseline comparison and residual variogram diagnostics.
